meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, so tell me why my son has a zero.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
Which date, Hale? I'm writing down 612 words and 11:52 PM. Is that all you have, or is there more than one edit?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe I'm wrong" isn't an answer, Hale. My being happy isn't the question. If the zero comes off, I want it in an email today, with confirmation that nothing goes on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You said in the meeting that you would remove the zero. I still require written confirmation that it is withdrawn and that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position; you offered to remove the zero, and she still wants that in writing along with confirmation that nothing goes on his record.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because you backed off with no document behind it, so the offer bought you nothing.
Try next time: when she asked which date the 612 words arrived, answer with the date and the next piece of evidence you have, rather than retreating.
